title: Counter (toy — HA-0.2 proof scenario)
prompt:
# PRD — Counter (toy)
PRD Standard: 1
Interface language: en-US

## 1. Problem and objective / Problema e objetivo

A single user needs a counter whose value survives page reloads.

## 2. Users and roles / Usuários e papéis

- Single user: reads and changes the shared counter without an account.

## 3. Scope and non-goals / Escopo e não objetivos

Increment and persistence are in scope; decrement, reset, multiple counters, authentication, and change history are excluded.

## 4. Primary journeys / Jornadas principais

1. The user increments the counter three times, reloads the page, and still sees three.

## 5. Screens and states / Telas e estados

A single counter screen exposes the current value, an Increment button, and loading, error, and success states.

## 6. Functional requirements / Requisitos funcionais

- **FR-001**: Clicking Increment adds one to the displayed counter.
- **FR-002**: The last counter value is restored after a page reload.

## 7. Conceptual data and ownership / Dados conceituais e propriedade

The application has one shared counter with an integer value that defaults to zero.

## 8. Business rules / Regras de negócio

- **BR-001**: Each successful Increment action increases the persisted value by exactly one.

## 9. Authentication and permissions / Autenticação e permissões

No authentication is required; the application has no sign-in, session, account, or cross-user boundary.

## 10. Non-functional requirements / Requisitos não funcionais

- **NFR-001**: The Increment button is keyboard accessible and exposes its accessible name.

## 11. Acceptance criteria / Critérios de aceite

- **AC-001** — Verifies: FR-001, FR-002, BR-001, NFR-001
  - Given the counter displays zero
  - When the user activates Increment three times and reloads the page
  - Then the accessible counter screen still displays three.

## 12. Assumptions / Premissas

None

## 13. Open decisions / Decisões em aberto

None
expectedCapabilities: Clicking Increment updates the displayed count.
The count survives a page reload.
